question: edit video by transcript
response_text:
As a content creator in the US, leveraging **text-based video editing** (also known as "edit-by-transcript" or "transcript-based editing") is one of the most effective ways to speed up your post-production workflow. Instead of scrubbing through a timeline, cutting waveforms, and manually matching audio to video, this approach allows you to edit your video the same way you would edit a Google Doc or a Word document—simply by deleting, copying, or rearranging text.
